question: Which of the following has been written by Munshi Premchand?
solution:
​The correct answer is __**Sevasadan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Seva Sadan** has been written by **Munshi Premchand**.
 
• **In 1919, Premchand's first major novel Seva Sadan was published in Hindi**.
 
• **The novel was originally written in Urdu under the title Bazaar-e-Husn** but was published in Hindi first by the name **Sevasadan** a Calcutta-based publisher.
